description: Sample XML single-record mapping for the BA-facing XML template (ADR 0019). Worked example: a customer feed of repeated <record> elements, each with a nested <customer> (id as an attribute) and a <transactions> block. Each field carries an `xml_xpath` (relative to the record element) instead of fixed-width position/length. `customer/@id` reads the id ATTRIBUTE; `customer/name` reads element text; `transactions/transaction` is a repeated child collapsed by the parser to an integer count column (TXN_COUNT_count).

fields.name: CUSTOMER_ID
fields.description: Customer identifier read from the customer element's `id` attribute. Record 9 omits the attribute to exercise nested_required.

fields.name: AGE
fields.description: Customer age (numeric element text). Record 10 carries 'NaN' to exercise the numeric check.

fields.name: STATUS
fields.description: Account status code (element text). Record 8 carries 'FROZEN' to exercise valid_values.

fields.name: TXN_COUNT
fields.description: Number of <transaction> children. The repeated-child XPath is collapsed by the XmlParser to an integer count column (TXN_COUNT_count). Record 6 carries an empty <transactions/> (count 0). Drive a 'must have at least one transaction' rule with the xml_array_length operator on this count.
